instruction: Install the PDF Import extension for LibreOffice to enable opening and editing PDF files

metadata.explanation: Task requires installing PDF Import extension for LibreOffice. Similar to the original LanguageTool task, this involves extension installation. The evaluator checks if pdfimport extension files (*.oxt) are present in the uno_packages cache directory.
metadata.verification_method: Pattern matching on grep output for pdfimport extension files in LibreOffice cache
